title: Stability of Slow-Fast Nonlinear Dynamics: Non-Periodic Case
summary: We present sufficient conditions for the semi-global exponential stability of nonlinear systems whose dynamics have both slow and fast time variations. Unlike most existing results, the fast variation is non-periodic, thereby allowing a wider class of systems, especially switched systems with fast (non-periodic) switching and those with quasi-periodic variations; we therefore rely on general averaging to construct an average system.
